protocol:
1. Opened the Bio-Rad T100 Thermal Cycler lid and exposed the heated block containing PCR-format wells.

2. Accessed the PCR-format tube/plate area in the thermal cycler and handled a clear reaction strip while holding an orange tube rack.

3. Arranged clear PCR strip tubes in a blue tube rack on the bench, with additional red/orange racks and pipettes positioned nearby.

4. Opened a pipette tip box and fitted a fresh tip onto a single-channel adjustable pipette.

5. Pipetted liquid reagent into individual clear PCR strip tubes seated in the blue rack.

6. Ejected the used pipette tip and prepared the single-channel pipette for the next reagent addition.

7. Adjusted a single-channel pipette and fitted a fresh tip from the tip box.

8. Aspirated liquid from a small microcentrifuge tube and dispensed it into PCR strip tubes in the blue rack.

9. Repeated single-channel pipetting into additional PCR strip tubes to complete a row of reactions.

10. Retrieved an 8-channel pipette and aligned it with a row of clear PCR strip tubes.

11. Loaded eight pipette tips onto the 8-channel pipette from a BIOTIX xTIP4 tip box.

12. Used the 8-channel pipette to transfer liquid between rows of PCR strip tubes in the orange rack and the blue rack.

13. Repeated the 8-channel transfer for another row of PCR strip tubes.

14. Opened a tube labeled H2O with a green cap and adjusted a single-channel pipette.

15. Aspirated H2O from the labeled tube using the single-channel pipette.

16. Positioned a clear PCR strip tube set in the blue rack and pressed the strip into the rack holes to secure it.

17. Labeled the PCR strip tubes with a white marker while the strip was seated in the blue rack.

18. Placed the prepared PCR strip tubes into the rotor of a benchtop mini centrifuge.

19. Closed the mini centrifuge lid to spin the PCR strip tubes.

20. Returned to the Bio-Rad T100 Thermal Cycler and used the touchscreen to select the thermal cycling program controls.

21. Entered run settings on the Bio-Rad T100 touchscreen keypad and proceeded with the thermal cycler setup.
